newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: CSFB sees Clariant H1 sales up 22 pct y/y.
newsitem.headline: CSFB sees Clariant H1 sales up 22 pct y/y.

text.p: CSFB said it expected speciality chemical company Clariant to report a 22 percent jump in first-half 1997 sales to around 1.39 billion Swiss francs and reiterated its hold recommendation for shares.

"We assume that exchange rates contributed around 12 percent to sales and acquisitions around four percent, while we estimate the underlying growth at six percent," analysts Simon Brown and Penny Tattersall wrote in a research note.
They put first-half operating profit at 153 million Swiss francs for a margin of 11 percent and net profit at 84 million, a six percent margin. -- Zurich newsroom +41 1 631 7340
